input:
Labeled defect
- root cause: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason to initialize reason, but raw has no underlying response object yet at construction time, so the attribute access dereferences None.
- failure path: Any call that builds a Response, such as every adapter.send or a plain Response(), raises AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'reason') before the object is populated, so no request can complete.

Reviewer finding
- description: Response.__init__ now assigns self.reason from self.raw.reason, but self.raw is initialized to None in the constructor, so this attribute access fails.
- rationale: Trigger: any construction of Response() before raw is assigned, such as a bare Response() in user code or tests. Mechanism: self.raw is None at this point, so self.raw.reason raises AttributeError. Impact: constructing a Response crashes instead of returning an object with reason unset.
critique: The finding identifies the same faulty operation: Response.__init__ reads self.raw.reason while raw is None at construction, which raises AttributeError. The labeled defect has the same mechanism and the same crash on any Response construction.
